hold.reason: The registry's Astro button sets no class since mzizi-registry 4.42.0 (#716, #708): its look moved to styles/pattern/mzizi-theme.css, which @bundu/ui does not ship. Taking it would leave every @bundu/ui/Button.astro unstyled. Removing classes is held for the major the owner coordinates across products (mzizi-registry docs/unstyled/decisions.md), so Button.astro and contracts/ui/button stay at registry 4.29.0 until then. Lift the hold in that major.

note: ref: the mzizi-registry commit the components and contracts are built from (pnpm registry:sync, pnpm contracts:check). hold: the items still built from an older commit, and why (scripts/registry-hold.mjs). tokensRef: the commit styles/density.css (the Bundu floor and spacing layers) is derived from (mzizi-registry v4.45.0). Omit tokensRef to use ref. Move any of them in a pull request: the diff is the review.
